tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Searches the writer's own pages, and what they told you in earlier conversations, for a name or a few words. Returns the matching passages in their words; the name of one of their pages returns that page. For their world only: it knows nothing about the real world.

query.description: A name from their pages, or a few of their words to look for

tools.name: look_up
tools.description: Looks up the real world on Wikipedia: history, science, places, people, how things work. Returns passages from the articles it finds. Not for the writer's own world: their names and inventions aren't there.

query.description: A few words naming the real-world thing to look up
